## 2. Parks and planning zones (PPRZ / PCRZ)

Both PPRZ and PCRZ are treated as recreational spaces in this study. PPRZ mainly represents public parks and recreation areas, while PCRZ represents conservation and natural areas.


### 3.4 Validate and correct coordinates

```{r}
# Convert coordinates
facility_df <- facility_df %>%
  mutate(
    latitude = as.numeric(latitude),
    longitude = as.numeric(longitude)
  )
```

```{r}
# Coordinate validity check
facility_df %>%
  summarise(
    missing_lat = sum(is.na(latitude)),
    missing_lon = sum(is.na(longitude)),
    min_lat = min(latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_lat = max(latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_lon = min(longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_lon = max(longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    invalid_lat = sum(
      !is.na(latitude) &
      (latitude < -39 | latitude > -34)
    ),
    
    invalid_lon = sum(
      !is.na(longitude) &
      (longitude < 140 | longitude > 150)
    )
  )
```

```{r}
facility_df <- facility_df %>%
  mutate(
    coordinate_status = case_when(
      is.na(latitude) | is.na(longitude) ~ "Missing",
      latitude < -39.2 | latitude > -33.98 |
        longitude < 140.96 | longitude > 150.04 ~ "Invalid",
      TRUE ~ "Valid"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
facility_df %>%
  count(coordinate_status)
```

```{r}
# Identify invalid coordinates
facility_df %>%
  filter(coordinate_status == "Invalid") %>%
  select(
    facility_id_1,
    lga_name,
    facility_name,
    suburb_town,
    pcode,
    latitude,
    longitude
  )
```

```{r}
# Resolve/review coordinate errors
facility_df <- facility_df %>%
  mutate(
    latitude_raw = latitude,
    longitude_raw = longitude
  )
```

```{r}
facility_df <- facility_df %>%
  mutate(
    
    latitude = case_when(
      # SWANHI: Swap latitude and longitude
      facility_id_1 %in% c("SWANHI5447", "SWANHI5448", "SWANHI5449") ~ longitude_raw,
      
      # MURRIN: Latitude decimal-place error
      facility_id_1 == "MURRIN5458" ~ -37.494546,
      facility_id_1 == "MURRIN5461" ~ -37.53826,
      
      # BENDIG5468: Outside Victoria, set to missing value.
      facility_id_1 == "BENDIG5468" ~ NA_real_,
      
      # Other cases, the original values ​​are retained.
      TRUE ~ latitude_raw
    ),
    
    longitude = case_when(
      # SWANHI: Swap latitude and longitude
      facility_id_1 %in% c("SWANHI5447", "SWANHI5448", "SWANHI5449") ~ latitude_raw,

      facility_id_1 == "BENDIG5468" ~ NA_real_,
      
      # Other cases, the original values ​​are retained.
      TRUE ~ longitude_raw
    )
  )
```

### 3.7 Create clean sport-level data

There are 9,590 records in the original dataset, corresponding to 5,000 unique facilities and multiple facility-sport/component records. The following code creates a clean sport-level dataset with selected columns.

```{r}
sport_level <- facility_df %>%
  select(
    facility_id = facility_id_1,
    facilty_sport_played_id,
    facility_name,
    lga_name_source,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    facility_ownership,
    facility_purpose,

    sports_played,
    number_of_field_courts,

    suburb_town,
    field_surface_type
  )

skim(sport_level)
```

### 3.8 Create clean facility-level data

The following code creates a clean facility-level dataset with one record per facility. The number of distinct sports and total number of fields/courts are calculated for each facility.

```{r}
collapse_unique <- function(x) {
  x <- sort(unique(na.omit(x)))
  
  if (length(x) == 0) {
    NA_character_
  } else {
    paste(x, collapse = "; ")
  }
}

facility_level <- facility_df %>%
    rename(
      facility_id = facility_id_1) %>%
  group_by(facility_id) %>%
  summarise(
    facility_name = first(facility_name),
    lga_name_source = first(lga_name_source),
    latitude = first(latitude),
    longitude = first(longitude),
    facility_ownership = first(na.omit(facility_ownership)),
    facility_purpose = first(na.omit(facility_purpose)),
    facility_category = first(na.omit(facility_category)),
    
    # number of distinct sports recorded at a facility
    n_sports = n_distinct(sports_played, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    sports_played = collapse_unique(sports_played),

    suburb_town = collapse_unique(suburb_town),

    field_surface_type = collapse_unique(field_surface_type),
    
    # total recorded fields/courts
    n_fields_courts = sum(
      number_of_field_courts,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  )

glimpse(facility_level)
skim(facility_level)
dim(facility_level)
n_distinct(facility_level$facility_id)
```

### 3.9 Assign facilities to LGAs

Use the 2026 LGA boundaries to assign LGA values to facilities.

```{r}
lga_2026 <- st_read(
  "data/LGA/LGA_POLYGON.shp",
  quiet = TRUE
)

lga_2026
st_crs(lga_2026)
```

```{r}
lga_2026_join <- lga_2026 %>%
  select(
    lga_code = LGA_CODE,
    lga_name_spatial = LGA_NAME,
    geometry
  )
```

#### facility_level

Spatial join was used as the primary method for assigning LGA based on facility coordinates. For records that could not be assigned through the spatial join, the standardised source LGA was matched to the official 2026 LGA lookup table as a fallback. This fallback was applied both to facilities without valid coordinates and to a small number of coordinate records that did not intersect an LGA polygon.

Of the 5,000 facility records, 4,680 had valid coordinates and were processed using spatial joining. The remaining 320 records without valid coordinates were assigned using the standardised source LGA. Among the 4,680 spatial records, 9 could not be matched to an LGA polygon and were subsequently assigned using the standardised source LGA as a fallback.

After the first join, there are still 2 records with missing LGA codes. The source dataset uses the old/official council name, whereas the 2026 spatial LGA dataset uses the standard LGA name. Bendigo City Council need to be converted to Greater Bendigo City Council, and Borough of Queenscliffe need to be converted to Queenscliffe Council. The following code manually corrects these two records.

```{r}
#  Standardized source LGA
facility_level <- facility_level %>%
  mutate(
    lga_name_standard = lga_name_source %>%
      str_remove(" Rural City Council$") %>%
      str_remove(" Shire Council$") %>%
      str_remove(" City Council$") %>%
      str_remove(" Borough Council$") %>%
      str_to_upper() %>%
      str_trim()
  )
```

```{r}
facility_level <- facility_level %>%
  mutate(
    lga_name_standard = case_when(
      lga_name_standard == "BENDIGO" ~ "GREATER BENDIGO",
      lga_name_standard == "BOROUGH OF QUEENSCLIFFE" ~ "QUEENSCLIFFE",
      TRUE ~ lga_name_standard
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# Set up LGA lookup
lga_lookup <- lga_2026 %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  transmute(
    lga_code = as.character(LGA_CODE),
    lga_name_spatial = LGA_NAME
  )
```

**4680 spatial join:**

There are 4,680 records with valid coordinates that can be spatially joined to the LGA boundaries.

```{r}
facility_coord_sf <- facility_level %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(longitude),
    !is.na(latitude)
  ) %>%
  st_as_sf(
    coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
    crs = 4326,
    remove = FALSE
  )
```

```{r}
lga_2026_join <- lga_2026_join %>%
  st_transform(st_crs(facility_coord_sf))

st_crs(facility_coord_sf)
st_crs(lga_2026_join)
```

```{r}
facility_coord_sf <- facility_coord_sf %>%
  st_join(
    lga_2026_join,
    join = st_intersects,
    left = TRUE
  )
```

```{r}
# Create spatial LGA assignment
facility_coord_lga <- facility_coord_sf %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(
    facility_id,
    lga_code,
    lga_name_spatial
  )
```

```{r}
# Check for any records that still have missing LGA codes after the spatial join
facility_coord_lga %>%
  filter(is.na(lga_code)) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

After the spatial join, 4,671 records were successfully assigned to an LGA. Nine records could not be assigned to an LGA through the spatial join. There are 9 records with valid coordinates that could not be assigned to an LGA through the spatial join. For these nine records, the standardised source LGA was used as a fallback and matched to the official 2026 LGA lookup table.

```{r}
# Identify the 9 records that failed the spatial join
facility_coord_lga_missing <- facility_coord_lga %>%
  filter(is.na(lga_code)) %>%
  select(facility_id)
```

```{r}
facility_coord_lga_fallback <- facility_level %>%
  filter(facility_id %in% facility_coord_lga_missing$facility_id) %>%
  select(
    facility_id,
    lga_name_standard
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    lga_lookup %>%
      rename(
        lga_code_lookup = lga_code,
        lga_name_lookup = lga_name_spatial
      ),
    by = c(
      "lga_name_standard" = "lga_name_lookup"
    )
  ) 
```

```{r}
facility_coord_lga <- facility_coord_lga %>%
  left_join(
    facility_coord_lga_fallback,
    by = "facility_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    lga_code = coalesce(lga_code, lga_code_lookup),
    lga_name_spatial = coalesce(
      lga_name_spatial,
      lga_name_standard
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    facility_id,
    lga_code,
    lga_name_spatial
  )
```

```{r}
# Check for any records that still have missing LGA codes after the spatial join
facility_coord_lga %>%
  filter(is.na(lga_code)) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

**320 Non-spatial fallback:**

There are 320 records without coordinates, which cannot be spatially joined. However, we can use the original LGA values to assign LGA codes and names using a lookup table.

```{r}
facility_no_coord_lga <- facility_level %>%
  filter(
    is.na(latitude) | is.na(longitude)
  ) %>%
  select(
    facility_id,
    lga_name_standard
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    lga_lookup,
    by = c(
      "lga_name_standard" = "lga_name_spatial"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    facility_id,
    lga_code,
    lga_name_standard
  ) %>%
  rename(
    lga_name_spatial = lga_name_standard
  )
```

```{r}
# Check for any records that still have missing LGA codes after the non-spatial fallback
facility_no_coord_lga %>%
  filter(is.na(lga_code)) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r}
# Merging two LGA assignments
facility_lga <- bind_rows(
  facility_coord_lga,
  facility_no_coord_lga
)
```

```{r}
facility_lga %>%
  summarise(
    rows = n(),
    unique_facilities = n_distinct(facility_id),
    missing_lga_code = sum(is.na(lga_code)),
    missing_lga_name = sum(is.na(lga_name_spatial))
  )
```

```{r}
# Final merge of LGA values into facility_level dataset
facility_level <- facility_level %>%
  select(
    -any_of(c("lga_code", "lga_name_spatial"))
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    facility_lga,
    by = "facility_id"
  )
```

#### sport_level

LGA assignment was first established at the facility level using spatial joins for facilities with valid coordinates and a source-LGA fallback for facilities without coordinates. The resulting LGA assignments were then propagated to the sport-level records using the unique facility ID.

```{r}
sport_level <- sport_level %>%
  left_join(
    facility_level %>%
      select(
        facility_id,
        lga_code,
        lga_name_spatial
      ),
    by = "facility_id"
  )
```

## 4. Physical activity and health outcomes

### 4.1 Read and standardise VPHS records


```{r}


# Standardise LGA names
clean_lga <- function(x) {
  x |>
    str_to_upper() |>
    str_remove("\\s*\\([^)]*\\)\\s*$") |>
    str_replace_all("-", " ") |>
    str_squish() |>
    recode("MERRI BEK" = "MERRI-BEK")
}

# Combine all VPHS datasets
vphs_files <- c(
  activity  = "data/Victorian Population Health Survey 2023.xlsx",
  bmi       = "data/VPHS_BMI.xlsx",
  chronic   = "data/VPHS_chronic.xlsx",
  wellbeing = "data/VPHS_wellbeing.xlsx"
)

vphs_lga_long <- imap_dfr(
  vphs_files,
  \(path, source) {
    read_excel(path, col_types = "text") |>
      mutate(source = source)
  }
) |>
  filter(
    str_starts(`Stratified by`, "LGAs of "),
    `Estimate type` == "Age-adjusted",
    `Sub-population` != "Victoria"
  ) |>
  transmute(
    source,
    gender = Gender,
    indicator = Indicator,
    category = `Indicator category`,
    LGA_NAME = clean_lga(`Sub-population`),
    percent = as.numeric(`%`),
    lower_ci = as.numeric(LL),
    upper_ci = as.numeric(UL)
  )

```


### 4.2 Select outcome indicators


```{r}

outcome_spec <- tribble(
  ~key,          ~indicator,                            ~category,
  "inactive",    "1. Moderate to vigourous physical activity", "Less than moderate",
  "activity",    "1. Moderate to vigourous physical activity", "≥150 minutes/week",
  "obesity",     "3. All obese categories",              "Obese (BMI≥30)",
  "distress",    "(a) Level of psychological distress",  "High, or very high (K10 22+)",
  "poor_health", "1. Self-reported health status",       "Fair/Poor"
)

```



### 4.3 Create LGA-level outcome dataset


```{r}

outcomes_wide <- vphs_lga_long |>
  filter(gender == "People") |>
  inner_join(
    outcome_spec,
    by = c("indicator", "category")
  ) |>
  transmute(
    LGA_NAME,
    key,
    percent,
    ll = lower_ci,
    ul = upper_ci,
    se = (upper_ci - lower_ci) / 3.92
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = key,
    values_from = c(percent, ll, ul, se),
    names_glue = "{key}_{.value}"
  )

```

```{r}

# Join physical activity data with LGA boundaries
activity_map <- lga |>
  left_join(
    outcomes_wide |>
      select(LGA_NAME, activity_percent),
    by = "LGA_NAME"
  )

# Plot physical activity across Victoria
ggplot(activity_map) +
  geom_sf(
    aes(fill = activity_percent),
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.15
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "plasma",
    direction = -1,
    na.value = "grey90",
    name = "Activity (%)"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Physical Activity Across Victoria",
    subtitle = "Adults meeting ≥150 minutes/week of moderate-to-vigorous physical activity",
    caption = "Source: Victorian Population Health Survey 2023"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

```

## 5. SEIFA socioeconomic indicator

```{r}
seifa_vic <- seifa |>
  filter(State == "VIC") |>
  transmute(
    LGA_CODE = `2021 Local Government Area (LGA) Code`,
    LGA_NAME = str_to_upper(
      `2021 Local Government Area (LGA) Name`
    ),
    SEIFA_IRSAD = Score
  )

seifa_vic <- seifa_vic |>
  mutate(
    LGA_NAME = str_remove(
      LGA_NAME,
      "\\s*\\(VIC\\.\\)$"
      ),
    LGA_NAME = case_when(
      LGA_NAME == "MORELAND" ~ "MERRI-BEK",
      TRUE ~ LGA_NAME
      )
  ) |>
  filter(LGA_NAME != "UNINCORPORATED VIC")
```
